title: Revolving 4-barrel flintlock pistol, France 18th C. — gold & ivory (Denix-style)
subject: Denix replica 'Revolving 4 barrel flintlock pistol, France 18th. C.' (4-barrel revolving cluster, ivory grip, gilt furniture). Owner variant: ALL metal = gold (no steel), ivory grip, fires copper coins (Luka boss money items).
units: mm in dossier; spec authored in metres

barrel_cluster_length.note: ~0.54 * overall, measured off side reference photo (image 1)

barrel_diameter.note: muzzle photo (image 6): 4 barrels touching in diamond; bore ~10mm

barrel_center_radius.note: Rc = db/sqrt(2) so adjacent barrels touch; cluster outer ~31mm across

grip_drop.note: plow-handle grip diagonal, measured ratio off side photo

feature_inventory.barrels: 4 barrels in a diamond (2x2 rotated 45deg) cluster; octagonal/faceted at breech transitioning to round toward muzzle; fine fleur-de-lis engraving bands; turned ring grooves at the octa/round transition. src: images 1,2,3,6
feature_inventory.revolving: the 4-barrel cluster ROTATES about the bore axis to index the next barrel under the cock after each shot; gold clover muzzle-cap has 4 corner index pins. src: image 6, denix#revolving
feature_inventory.muzzle_cap: gold clover/diamond plate uniting the 4 muzzles, 4 small index pins at the diamond points. src: image 6
feature_inventory.collar_band: gold collar band wrapping the cluster near the breech. src: image 3
feature_inventory.breech: bulbous gold breech form at the rear of the cluster. src: image 3
feature_inventory.lock: flintlock on the right side: ornate engraved lockplate, S-shaped cock holding a flint in screw jaws, frizzen (battery) + frizzen spring, pan. Original = dark engraved steel; OWNER OVERRIDE = gold. src: images 1,2
feature_inventory.grip: ivory grip, plow-handle profile, gold acanthus scrollwork lines inlaid; both sides ivory. src: images 1,2,4,5
feature_inventory.pommel: ornate bulbous flared gold pommel cap with heavy baroque acanthus/scroll relief + rounded gold end-cap. src: images 4,5
feature_inventory.trigger: gold trigger inside a gold trigger guard bow. src: images 1,2
feature_inventory.ammo: OWNER FICTION: fires copper coins (matches Luka boss money items). Loose copper coin pile presented beside the weapon as ammo. src: owner

materials_override.all_metal: GOLD (#C9962E) — no steel anywhere per owner: barrels, muzzle cap, collar, breech, lock, cock, frizzen, trigger guard, trigger, pommel, scroll inlay
